#### Solution: nimble analysis



```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
nimble.model <- nimble::readBUGSmodel(
  model="regression2.bug",
  data=forNimble,
  inits=inits)
```

```{r echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE}
nimble.model <- nimble::readBUGSmodel(
  model="../../solution_bug/regression2.bug",
  data=forNimble,
  inits=inits)
```

```{r}
compiled.model = compileNimble(nimble.model)

conf <- configureMCMC(nimble.model)
conf$addMonitors(c("beta", "sigma", "y"))

# Build the MCMC
Rmcmc <- buildMCMC(conf)
Cmcmc <- compileNimble(Rmcmc, project = compiled.model)
```
```{r results = 'hide'}
samples <- runMCMC(Cmcmc, niter = 50000)
```

```{r}
samples[,c(1:3,25)] |>
  coda::as.mcmc() |>
  summary()
```

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=14}
samples[,c(1:3,25)] |>
  coda::as.mcmc() |>
  plot()
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
ymissing = samples[, 'y[22]']
# plot kernel density estimate
plot(density(ymissing), lwd=2, main = "Posterior prediction for y*")
# add vertical line
abline(v = y[22], col="red", lty=2, lwd=2)
```
